questions.question: Which two signs and two numbers should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct? 98 − 9 × 21 ÷ 7 + 56 = 69
questions.questionHtml:
Which two signs and two numbers should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

98 − 9 × 21 ÷ 7 + 56 = 69
questions.solution:
We apply the options to the given equation & solve it by using BODMAS rule:

Given Equation: 98 − 9 × 21 ÷ 7 + 56 = 69

Option 1) 56 and 9, + and ×

After Interchanging:

⇒ 98 − 56 + 21 ÷ 7 × 9 = 69

⇒ 98 − 56 + 3 × 9 = 69

⇒ 98 − 56 + 27 = 69

⇒ 125 - 56 = 69

⇒ 69 = 69

Given Equation: 98 − 9 × 21 ÷ 7 + 56 = 69

Option 2) 56 and 21, + and ×

After Interchanging:

⇒ 98 − 9 + 56 ÷ 7 × 21 = 69

⇒ 98 − 9 + 8 × 21 = 69

⇒ 98 − 9 + 168 = 69

⇒ 266 - 9 = 69

⇒ 257 ≠ 69

Given Equation: 98 − 9 × 21 ÷ 7 + 56 = 69

Option 3) 98 and 9, + and ×

After Interchanging:

⇒ 9 − 98 + 21 ÷ 7 × 56 = 69

⇒ 9 − 98 + 3 × 56 = 69

⇒ 9 − 98 + 168 = 69

⇒ 177 - 98 = 69

⇒ 79 ≠ 69

Given Equation: 98 − 9 × 21 ÷ 7 + 56 = 69

Option 4) 21 and 7, + and −

After Interchanging:

⇒ 98 − 9 + 7 ÷ 21 × 56 = 69

⇒ 98 − 9 + 0.33 × 56 = 69

⇒ 98 − 9 + 18.66 = 69

⇒ 116.66 - 9 = 69

⇒ 107.66 ≠ 69

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.questionHtml: Which of the following is a right bank tributary of the Ganga?
questions.solution: Son River is a right bank tributary of the Ganga, flowing through central India. It originates near Amarkantak Hill in Chhattisgarh and joins the Ganges River near Patna, Bihar. It is the second-largest tributary of the Ganga in the south after the Yamuna River. The Koilwar Bridge over the Son River connects Arrah and Patna and is India's oldest river bridge. squaring both sides, we get

⇒ m2 = sec2 θ + tan2 θ + 2(sec θ)(tan θ) ⇒ m2 = 1 + tan2 θ + tan2 θ + 2(sin) / (cos2 θ) ⇒ m2 = 1 + 2tan2 θ + 2(sin) / (cos2 θ)⇒ m2 = \( 1 + \frac{2sin^2 θ}{cos^2 θ} + \frac{2sin θ}{cos^2 θ}\) ⇒ m2 = \( \frac{cos^2 θ+2sin^2 θ+2sin θ}{cos^2 θ} \)

Applying componendo and dividendo rule,

Key Points

  • To different people, formal forgiveness might signify many things.

  • Therefore, absolution is the correct substitution for formal forgiveness of a person’s sins. 

Additional Information

  • Absolutism means the adoption of unbreakable beliefs in theology, philosophy, or politics.  (निरंकुश राज्य का सिद्धान्त)

Key Points

  • An antonym, unlike a synonym, is a word in the same language with the exact opposite meaning.
  • The term is derived from the Greek words "anti" and "onym," which mean "opposite" and "name," accordingly.
  • Consent is described as the acceptance of something.
  • Interdiction is the act of restricting or refusing something.
  • Therefore, 'interdiction' is the antonym of 'consent'. 

Additional Information

  • Let's have a look at the meaning of other words given in options:-
    • Bickering - argue about petty and trivial matters. (छोटी-छोटी बातों पर बहस करना)
    • Expulsion - the action of forcing someone to leave an organization. (किसी को संगठन छोड़ने के लिए मजबूर करने की क्रिया)
    • Directive - an official or authoritative instruction. (एक आधिकारिक निर्देश)
  • The antonym of Bickering is Agree.

Q. inshore waters of the northern

R. Gulf of Mexico, especially in Louisiana waters,

S. which are their primary feeding grounds
questions.solution:

  • The first part will be P as it continues the fixed part i.e. "Kemp's ridleys are usually found in nearshore and".

  • The third part will be R as the adjective 'northern' should be a followed by a noun i.e. "Gulf of Mexico".
  • The fourth part is S as it further explains about how the Kemp's ridleys are related to Louisiana waters.
  • The meaning will be "principal feeding sites for Kemp's ridleys are the nearshore and inshore waters of the northern Gulf of Mexico, particularly in Louisiana waters".

questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. It not only distances the addict from his/her social circles but also impacts their productivity badly.

B. People begin drinking just for the sake of it and gradually make it a habit.

C. Addiction of any kind, including alcoholic addiction impacts all aspects of an individual’s life.

D. Once it becomes a habit, it does not require much to change into an addiction.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "BDCA"

Key Points

  • The most appropriate option to order a meaningful and coherent paragraph is 'BDCA.'
  • Sentence B should come first as it is the introduction of the paragraph.
  • Sentence D should come second as it explains what happens once drinking becomes a habit.
  • Sentence C should come third as it tells about addiction in general and that it impacts all aspects of an individual’s life.
  • Sentence A  should come last as it explains the impacts of addiction.
  • Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.
    ​

Correct Sequence: People begin drinking just for the sake of it and gradually make it a habit. Once it becomes a habit, it does not require much to change into an addiction. Addiction of any kind, including alcoholic addiction impacts all aspects of an individual’s life. It not only distances the addict from his / her social circles but also impacts their productivity badly.
